{{redirect|Pokémon: Johto League Champions|the Italian opening for this season|Pokémon, The Johto League Champions}} {{redirect|S4|the TCG release with the set symbol S4|Vivid Voltage (TCG)}} {{Season Infobox |background=FFCB49 |cellcolor=DDD |name=Pokémon: Johto League Champions |image=Season4 logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=4 |opening=Born to Be a Winner |numeps=52 |region=[[Johto]] |series={{aniseries|GS}} |prev=Pokémon: The Johto Journeys |next=Pokémon: Master Quest }} '''Pokémon: Johto League Champions''' is the fourth [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is the second season of {{aniseries|GS}}. It follows the adventures of {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} in the [[Johto]] [[region]], from [[Goldenrod City]] up to [[Cianwood City]]. It originally aired as part of the 2001-2002 {{DL|Pokémon in the United States|Kids' WB!}} Saturday morning lineup. The season began with ''[[EP158|A Goldenrod Opportunity]]'', which originally aired on August 18, 2001, and ended with ''[[EP209|Machoke, Machoke Man!]]'', which originally aired on September 7, 2002. It is preceded by [[S03|Pokémon: The Johto Journeys]] and succeeded by [[S05|Pokémon: Master Quest]]. ==Blurb== ''From the sprawling metropolis of Goldenrod City to the icy peak of Snowtop Mountain, the Johto region presents Ash, Misty, and Brock with exciting new adventures—along with a few familiar faces like their old friends Todd, Duplica, and Suzie! Johto’s rich past means plenty of Pokémon mysteries for our heroes to solve, and its exciting present means some tough challenges—Ash tackles three more Gyms, while handling competitions like the Pokémon Sumo Conference along the way.'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} * [[Todd Snap]] travels with {{Ash}}.
